newsitem.title: INDIA: VSNL to offer 600,000 shares in India.
newsitem.headline: VSNL to offer 600,000 shares in India.

text.p: Indian telcommunications firm Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd (VSNL) will offer 600,000 shares on domestic markets after the launch of its Global Depositary Receipts issue, B.K. Syngal the managing director of the company said on Thursday.
"There will be an issue of 600,000 shares to domestic retail investors shortly after the GDR issue and there will also be a share issue to employees," Syngal said.
"The details of the actual offer will be decided only after the GDR issue," he added.
VSNL is issuing 18.9 million shares in the form of 37.8 million GDR's which will be listed on the London Stock Exchange.
The GDR issue price will be decided around March 25, and roadshows begin in Hong Kong on Monday.
VSNL shares closed at 1,075 rupees on the Bombay Stock Exchange on Thursday, up 38 rupees.
